message.content: Customer Jane Doe at 123 Palm Ave Sarasota FL 34236 called 941-555-0142 (jane@example.com) asking why the lawn got brown patches after last week's rain — we had just fertilized.

content.text: Likely gray leaf spot: summer rain plus fresh nitrogen on St. Augustine invites fungus. Worth a post on rain-after-fertilizer timing for Sarasota lawns.
